Facts:
- Role: Analyst
- Employment type: contractor
- Security training: basic (not advanced)
- System: Payroll (owned by Payroll Specialist role)

Policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

Belinda is a contractor. Contractors never get admin. No advanced security training, so maximum is read.

Requested admin, above maximum (read), so grant maximum = read.

Both notes recommend read. Decision: read.
